_comment_purpose: redroid-seccomp-l0b.json — PROPOSED hardened seccomp BPF profile for a Magisk-rooted ReDroid 12 L0b cell. This is a PROPOSAL ARTIFACT (Phase 6), NOT the pinned production profile. It is an exact copy of agents/stability/stack/seccomp/redroid-seccomp.json with ONE clearly-commented added ALLOW block (the PHASE5-AMENDMENT block) covering the 4 load-bearing syscalls (personality, arch_prctl, mount, setns) that Phase 5 proved are required for a Magisk-rooted ReDroid 12 to boot under enforcing seccomp. defaultAction remains SCMP_ACT_ERRNO (still enforcing, still allowlist style). Everything else is byte-for-byte identical to the production profile.
_comment_hardening: Hardening posture vs. Docker's default seccomp + the earlier emulator-builder draft: (1) defaultAction is SCMP_ACT_ERRNO not SCMP_ACT_ALLOW; (2) process_vm_readv / process_vm_writev are REMOVED from allow; (3) ptrace is restricted to PTRACE_TRACEME (request==0) via arg filter — PTRACE_ATTACH/PEEK/POKE return EPERM; (4) PHASE6-NOTE: mount(2) is NO LONGER restricted to MS_BIND in this proposed L0b profile (see PHASE5-AMENDMENT group) because ReDroid init's tmpfs/proc/sysfs mounts and Magisk's `magisk --setup-sbin` tmpfs at /sbin are non-bind and seccomp CANNOT filter the fstype string (it is a userspace pointer arg); (5) init_module / finit_module / delete_module / create_module / query_module / kexec_load / kexec_file_load / reboot / iopl / ioperm / acct / quotactl / nfsservctl / vhangup / pivot_root / uselib / ustat / sysfs / setdomainname / sethostname remain DENIED by default (not listed in any allow group). PHASE6-NOTE: personality and setns, previously DENIED in the production profile, are now ALLOWED in this proposed L0b profile (see PHASE5-AMENDMENT group) — re-permitting them is the documented widening required for a rooted boot. process_vm_readv/writev stay removed; ptrace stays PTRACE_TRACEME-only.
_comment_compliance: refuse-privileged-compose §4 + agents/orchestrator/SPEC.md §4 compliant. NOT a substitute for cap_drop:[ALL], no-new-privileges:true, or image digest pinning. PROPOSAL — board review required before promotion (re-permits personality + setns; relaxes mount MS_BIND filter).
_proposal_provenance: Phase 6 (audit/phase6-hardened-boot-2026-05-30.md) — empirically validated full boot+root under enforcing seccomp. Amendment list derived from Phase 5 (audit/phase5-hardened-l0b-2026-05-30.md §4).

syscalls._group: PHASE5-AMENDMENT (CONDITION-2): minimal additions required for a Magisk-rooted ReDroid 12 to BOOT and ROOT under enforcing seccomp (defaultAction stays SCMP_ACT_ERRNO). Each entry is load-bearing with kernel type=1326 / F-libc evidence in audit/phase5-hardened-l0b-2026-05-30.md §3 and validated end-to-end in audit/phase6-hardened-boot-2026-05-30.md. arch_prctl(158): Bionic linker sets the TLS base (ARCH_SET_FS) at the start of EVERY process; denied -> null-TLS segfault in linker64 (container exits 139 before init logs). personality(135): Bionic reads/sets process personality on every zygote-forked app; denied -> 'F libc: error getting old personality value' -> zygote crash-loop -> no boot. setns(308): magiskd enters the per-process mount namespace for its module bind-mount overlay; denied -> magiskd namespace path EPERMs (degrades Magisk module mount-ns isolation). mount(165): re-permitted for NON-BIND filesystems (ReDroid init tmpfs/proc/sysfs + magisk --setup-sbin tmpfs at /sbin); the production profile's MS_BIND-only arg-filter on this syscall is intentionally REPLACED by this unfiltered allow here because seccomp cannot narrow by fstype string. SECURITY TRADE-OFF: this widens the profile (re-permits personality+setns, drops the MS_BIND mask on mount). It does NOT touch the strongest restrictions: process_vm_readv/writev stay removed, ptrace stays PTRACE_TRACEME-only, init_module/kexec_*/pivot_root/swapon stay denied. Bounded by no-new-privileges:true + cap_drop:[ALL] of all NON-curated caps + not --pid=host / --network=host. CORRECTION (seccomp-promotion-audit 2026-06-01): an earlier version of this sentence stated CAP_SYS_ADMIN was absent from the curated set — that was FACTUALLY WRONG. CAP_SYS_ADMIN IS in the curated HARDENED_CAP_ADD set (SPEC §4 mandates it for ReDroid boot), so setns/mount are NOT bounded by its absence; setns+CAP_SYS_ADMIN is the top residual risk — mitigate via the recommended setns->CLONE_NEWNS arg-filter (proof/seccomp-promotion-audit/RESULT.md §5) before promotion.

filesystem-and-namespace-core (Android boot + Magisk overlay needs; ptrace and mount are intentionally NOT here — see arg-filtered groups below. PHASE6-NOTE: mount is now in the PHASE5-AMENDMENT group above (unfiltered), so the magisk-mount-bind-only arg-filtered group below is retained for documentation/traceability but is superseded by the broader allow.)

magisk-mount-bind-only (PHASE6-SUPERSEDED: this MS_BIND-only arg-filter on mount is now superseded by the unfiltered mount allow in the PHASE5-AMENDMENT group above. Retained here for traceability against the production profile. cpuinfo-overlay's service.sh issues `mount --bind /data/adb/modules/cpuinfo-overlay/system/etc/cpuinfo.spoofed /proc/cpuinfo` which sets MS_BIND.)

magisk-mount-unbind-and-namespace (umount/umount2/move_mount/open_tree/fsopen/fsconfig/fsmount/fspick/mount_setattr — required by Magisk's late_start_service to manage bind-mount lifecycle inside its mnt namespace; pivot_root, swapon, swapoff intentionally NOT included)

namespace-create (Android zygote + Magisk magiskhide. PHASE6-NOTE: setns is now ALLOWED in the PHASE5-AMENDMENT group above — magiskd requires it for per-process mount-namespace re-entry. The production profile's exclusion comment is preserved for traceability: 'setns intentionally NOT here — namespace re-entry would let escaped uid attach to host PID namespace'. In this L0b profile setns is bounded by no-new-privileges:true + cap_drop:[ALL] of NON-curated caps + not --pid=host. CORRECTION (audit 2026-06-01): CAP_SYS_ADMIN IS present in the curated HARDENED_CAP_ADD set (the earlier absent-from-set claim was false); setns+CAP_SYS_ADMIN is the top residual risk — see proof/seccomp-promotion-audit/RESULT.md.)

ptrace-TRACEME-only (request==PTRACE_TRACEME==0). PTRACE_ATTACH (16), PTRACE_PEEK* (1/2/3), PTRACE_POKE* (4/5/6) all return EPERM via defaultAction because this arg-filtered allow does not cover them. magiskhide's tracer-pid scrub on hidden processes WILL fail; L4 Shamiko (L0b-level Zygisk hide) is the intended root-hiding mechanism and does not require host-side ptrace.
perf-and-bpf (Android Profiler + RenderScript dispatch). bpf is allowed but kernel BPF JIT must be off on host.

explicit-deny-documentation (these are denied because defaultAction=SCMP_ACT_ERRNO and they appear in NO allow group above; listed here for auditor traceability only). PHASE6-NOTE: personality and setns have been MOVED OUT of this deny list into the PHASE5-AMENDMENT allow group above. Remaining forbidden syscalls: process_vm_readv, process_vm_writev, init_module, finit_module, delete_module, create_module, query_module, kexec_load, kexec_file_load, reboot, iopl, ioperm, acct, quotactl, lookup_dcookie, nfsservctl, vhangup, pivot_root, swapon, swapoff, uselib, ustat, sysfs, setdomainname, sethostname.
